subject: Desperately need some help! ImageRename issue that needs to be fixed

messages.author: 7544ac5103fe3a16
messages.subject: Desperately need some help! ImageRename issue that needs to be fixed
parts:
Dear community,

I have a recurring problem I can't figure out and I had the same issue last year. I have tried on two different computers and tried to understand where the problem comes from but I really don't get it.

It is at the ImageRename stage.

All the raw images were correctly copied into their respective folder but when it copies all photos and rename them all the photos are mixed up (within a station) between the two camera folders, and camera names are incorrectly allocated. The only solution I have is to process these one by one separately but that would take forever because it is almost all stations that have the same problem.

Please find attached the .csv file output of the ImageRename function and you will see what I mean.

I am sending also my Survey_design.csv file in case the problem comes from this?

And this is the code used:

library(reshape)
library(lattice)
library(Rcpp)
library(unmarked)
library(camtrapR)
library(methods)
library(overlap)

camtraps <- read.csv("Survey_design.csv")
camtraps

raw_images <- file.path(getwd(), "raw_images")

StationFolderCreate <- createStationFolders(inDir = raw_images,
stations = as.character(camtraps$Station),
cameras = as.character(camtraps$Camera),
createinDir = TRUE)
StationFolderCreate

raw_images <- file.path(getwd(), "raw_images")
images_renamed <- file.path(getwd(), "images_renamed")

if (Sys.which("exiftool") != ""){
renaming.table <- imageRename(inDir = raw_images,
outDir = images_renamed,
hasCameraFolders = TRUE,
keepCameraSubfolders = TRUE,
createEmptyDirectories = TRUE,
copyImages = TRUE,
writecsv = TRUE
)
}


I really hope someone can help me.
Thank you.
Best,
Camille.

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Desperately need some help! ImageRename issue that needs to be fixed
parts:
Hi all,
the issue is solved and the development version on github contains the fix already, and so will the next CRAN release.

Background: for some reason, exiftool on her system returned the camera directories in reverse alphabetical order. So "CI" came before "CH". But then imageRename assigns camera IDs as CH, then CI. I don't know why it happened in the first place, even with up-to-date Exiftool and R, on a Mac. I couldn't replicate it, even with exactly the same data (on Windows).
But now imageRename first sorts the images by Camera directory before assigning camera IDs. That fixed it.
Cheers
Jürgen
